newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds closed weaker, tradeless.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds closed weaker, tradeless.

text.p: UK meals and feeds closed tradeless but easier, due to overnight losses, traders said.
The slight upturn in early trading on the Chicago soybean meal futures wasn't expect to have much impact on UK prices on Thursday, unless a significant rally in Chicago occurs before its close.
A lack of demand from compounders and the fact that market is naturally quiet at this time of year, was the reason cited behind the lack of trade.
Soybean meal selling levels fell around 3.50 sterling per tonne, while rapemeal shed mostly two sterling per tonne.
